 Most recent Most popular 'Great assist from Nkunku' published at 21:24 GMT 21:24 GMT 
 RB Leipzig 2-2 Man City 
 Lucy Ward 
Former Leeds striker on TNT 
 Brilliant finish from Nusa, but it's terrific awareness from Leipzig. It's a great run from Bruda, a great ball across from Nkunku. He knew that Nusa had that little bit of space in front of him, and plays a first-time ball.
 The finish is excellent, but it is a great assist from Nkunku.

 RB Leipzig 2-2 Man City 
 Leipzig’s Antonio Nusa has scored his second goal in 16 Champions League appearances, and first since his competition debut for Club Brugge v Porto in September 2022.

 GOAL - RB Leipzig 2-2 Man City published at 21:20 GMT 21:20 GMT 
 Antonio Nusa (61 mins) 
 Leipzig come from behind...Again!
 The ball is chipped up by substitute Christopher Nkunku just on the edge of the area and it's a fine finish from Antonio Nusa , slotted into the bottom far corner.
 Another brilliant response from the hosts.
 975 417 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Como hit six past Lens published at 21:20 GMT 21:20 GMT 
 Lens 0-6 Como; Borussia Dormund 1-0; PSV 
 Image source, EPA Three goals in quick succession for Como and Lens are in big, big trouble. 
 Lucas da Cunha sweeps past goalkeeper Robin Risser straight after the re-start, Marc Oliver Kempf heads in another, while Tasos Douvikas bags his hat-trick and adds Como's sixth with a fine finish.
 And Borussia Dortmund are finally up and running against Real Betis. Former Wolves forward Fabio Silva taps home the rebound from Jobe Bellingham's shot.
 PSV move level with Club Brugge after Kodai Sano's strike takes a deflection and bounces in.

 'At last a bit of quality from City' published at 21:20 GMT 21:20 GMT 
 RB Leipzig 1-2 Man City 
 Nedum Onuoha 
Former Man City defender on MOTD: UEFA Champions League 
 At last, a bit of quality from City and it gets them a goal. A great ball into the box and then Enzo Fernandez does what you want him to do.
 You can hear more from Onuoha on MOTD: Uefa Champions League at 22:40 BST on BBC One and the BBC Sport website and app.

 GOAL - RB Leipzig 1-2 Man City published at 21:17 GMT 21:17 GMT 
 Enzo Fernandez (58 mins) 
 Well that is more like it from Manchester City.
 A simple but perfectly timed and weighted pass from Iliman Ndiaye on the left and it's on a plate for Enzo Fernandez on the edge of the six-yard box. The Argentine nods home despite being under a bit of pressure.
 Leipzig's lead did not last long.

 Baku 'sneaks it in the near post' published at 21:14 GMT 21:14 GMT

Former Leeds striker on TNT 
 Great little ball and great awareness that Baku would force the run, and he just passes it past Donnarumma, who gave him the space at that near post. Everyone expecting a cross and he just sneaks it in at the near post.

 A brilliant reaction save from Maarten Vandevoordt denies what feels like Erling Haaland's first genuine opportunity of the match.
 The Norwegian wriggles free and fires from close range but it's a good save from the Leipzig keeper.
